theorem wick_excludes (ht : EuclideanAsymptotic F A)(hA : 0<A) (P:Palette Flavor)(q w:PolyField Flavor) :
    ¬ ∀ f g:Probe E4, HasCompactSupport ⇑(waveTest (productTest f g)) →
       F.A.world.W 2 (pairV F.action.J (pinned F)) (productTest f g)= P.wicks q w (waveTest (productTest f g)) := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩:= P.wicks_painted q w; exact fun h=> polynomial_excludes ht hA x fun f g H=> (h f g H).trans (hx _ (SchwartzMap.continuous _) H).symm

proof_context.conclusion: Under `EuclideanAsymptotic F A` and `0 < A`, the Wightman two-point function does not equal `P.wicks q w` on all product tests with compactly supported wave transform; it reduces to `polynomial_excludes` through `wicks_painted`.

theorem polynomial_excludes (ht : EuclideanAsymptotic F A) (hA : 0<A) (W : Collection) :
    ¬ ∀ f g : Probe E4, HasCompactSupport ⇑(waveTest (productTest f g)) →
       F.A.world.W 2 (pairV F.action.J (pinned F)) (productTest f g)=tests W (waveTest (productTest f g)) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨μ,hμ,hM⟩:=traceSpectrum_exists F
    apply euclidean_excludes ht hA W
    apply mostly.mono; intro x hx; apply identifies_euclid hμ W _ _ hx.1
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := hv.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0:E4)
    obtain ⟨u,hu⟩:= probe_one (Nat.ceil p)
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩:= testPlus_onto (Probe.sew (testPlus u) v)
    have he : waveTest (productTest u w)=v := by
        ext1 x
        rw [waveTest_product,hw,Probe.sews,← mul_assoc]
        by_cases hx : v x=0
        · rw [hx,mul_zero]
        have ht := hu x ((closedBall_subset_closedBall (Nat.le_ceil p)) (hp (subset_tsupport v hx)))
        have he : ‖testPlus u x‖^2=(1:ℝ) := by exact congr_arg (fun y : ℝ≥0 => (↑y:ℝ)) ht
        rw [mul_comm (star _),Complex.star_def,Complex.mul_conj,Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,he,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul]
    rw [← he,← hμ.absolute]; exact h u w (he.symm ▸ hv)

proof_context.conclusion: Equality on product tests gives equality on every compactly supported `v` (`probe_one`, `testPlus_onto`), hence via `identifies_euclid` equality of `euclidean F` and `atPoint W` near 0, which `euclidean_excludes` refutes.

lemma identifies_euclid (hs : TraceSpectrum F μ) (t : Collection) (h : ∀ f : Probe E4, HasCompactSupport ⇑f→(∫ p,f p ∂μ)=tests t f)
    (s : ℝ) (hS : 0<s) : euclidean F s=atPoint t s := by
    obtain ⟨w,hx,hW⟩ := approximate s
    haveI ht := hs.damped_mass _ hS
    have hh : Integrable (fun p => Real.exp (-s*time p)) μ := by
        have hp : Integrable (fun _ : E4 => (1:ℝ)) (OS.Semigroup.transform timeAxis s μ) := integrable_const _
        have he := (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul (OS.Semigroup.measurable ..)).1 hp
        apply Integrable.congr he; exact ae_of_all _ fun p=> (by change Real.exp _ * 1=_; rw [mul_one]; rfl)
    rw [heat_value s hS hs]
    refine tendsto_nhds_unique_of_eventuallyEq (f:=fun n => ∫ p,w n p ∂μ) ?_ (reads t s hS w (fun i => (hx i).2) hW)
        (Eventually.of_forall fun n=>h _ (hx n).1)
    exact tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence _ (fun i => (w i).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable) hh (fun i=> ae_of_all _ (hx i).2) (ae_of_all _ hW)

proof_context.conclusion: Equality on compactly supported tests implies `euclidean F s = atPoint t s` for all `s > 0`, approximating `exp (-s time p)` by compact cutoffs (`approximate`) and using dominated convergence (`reads`).

lemma exhibit_painted {n} (arcs:Fin n→Hue) : Painted (exhibit arcs) := by
    let V:= (i:Fin n) → Fin (arcs i).num.l; letI : Fintype V:=by unfold V; infer_instance
    let m (p:V):Track:=⟨n,fun i=>(arcs i).monochrome (p i)⟩
    let a (p:V) : ℂ :=∏ i, (arcs i).num.c (p i)
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩:=Painted.sum Finset.univ (fun p : V=>fun v:E4→ℂ=> a p * (m p).read v) fun p=> Painted.times (painted_tariff _) _
    refine ⟨x,?_⟩; intro f he hW
    rw [hx _ he hW,exhibit]; simp_rw [Track.read,← integral_const_mul]
    have hr:=fun p:V=> ((m p).read_int he hW).const_mul (a p)
    rw [← integral_finsetSum (μ:=volume (α:= Fin n → Space3)) (f:=fun p:V => fun k=> a p*(m p).tariff f k) Finset.univ (fun p _=>hr p)];
    congr! 1; ext1 k
    simp_rw [Hue.coloration]
    rw [Fintype.prod_sum, Finset.sum_mul]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _; unfold Track.tariff; rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib,Complex.real_smul];
    rw [show ∑ i,(arcs i).forward (k i)=(m p).order k from rfl, mul_assoc]; unfold a Track.weight; rw [Complex.ofReal_prod]

proof_context.conclusion: Expanding the numerators into monomials, `exhibit arcs` is a finite combination of mode reads (`Painted`).
